statement: The existing canonical JSON serializer admits only dense own-data arrays and canonical records at every depth, refuses cycles and caller-owned option accessors or proxies without invoking them, and preserves useful deterministic serialization and digests for ordinary acyclic data. Diagnostics consumes this sole owner directly without a forwarding compatibility module.

constraints.statement: Change the existing canonical JSON serializer and its direct diagnostics imports. No CDC, system-row capture, authority token, lifecycle or storage migration belongs to this PR. Preserve the existing TypeError contract and useful acyclic serialization.

Preserve the original source and failure evidence, independently review the extracted patch and execute the selected tests, generators and static gates only on physical lab machines. No retry-once, timeout increase, baseline waiver, skip or fabricated acceptance receipt.
